'''Imperial beast tamers''' were members of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] who weaponized wild creatures for the Empire. They utilized cruel practices to make creatures more violent<ref name="Bestial Fury" />, allowing them to be used as weapons for the Empire.<ref name="Unchained">{{SWIA|set=Return to Hoth|cardname=Unchained|link=https://imperial-assault.fandom.com/wiki/Unchained|archiveurl=https://archive.is/TXyJJ}}</ref>
